definitions.explanation: Describes food that is intensely spicy or hot. A colloquial intensified form of 辛い, commonly used in food culture and marketing.

examples.japanese: この{激辛|げきから}ラーメンは{本当|ほんとう}に{辛|から}い。
examples.english: This super-spicy ramen is really hot.

examples.japanese: {激辛|げきから}{料理|りょうり}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}してみた。
examples.english: I tried challenging myself with extremely spicy food.

examples.japanese: このカレーは{激辛|げきから}で{有名|ゆうめい}だから、{苦手|にがて}な{人|ひと}はやめたほうがいい。
examples.english: This curry is famous for being extremely spicy, so people who can't handle it should avoid it.

notes:
A popular compound of {激|げき} (extreme) + {辛|から} (spicy). Widely used in Japanese food culture, especially on menus, food packaging, and TV shows featuring spicy food challenges. Functions as a na-adjective modifier or noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激辛|げきから}ラーメン — super-spicy ramen
- {激辛|げきから}カレー — extremely hot curry
- {激辛|げきから}{料理|りょうり} — intensely spicy food
- {激辛|げきから}チャレンジ — spicy food challenge

RELATED WORDS:
- {辛口|からくち} — spicy/dry (for food or drink); milder than {激辛|げきから}
- {大辛|おおから} — extra spicy; a step below {激辛|げきから} on many menus
- {甘口|あまくち} — mild (opposite end of the spiciness scale)
